### Discovery & Translational Science

* **Metabolically activated molecular glues expand targeted protein degradation design** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42665644/)
  * Investigators detailed a novel class of metabolically activated molecular glues that require enzymatic biotransformation to induce target-protein interactions.

* **Serotonin receptor agonism shows antitumor activity in colorectal cancer models** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42665645/)
  * Preclinical findings demonstrate that direct activation of specific serotonin receptors suppresses cell proliferation and tumor growth in colorectal cancer models.

* **Viral protease activity identified as upstream trigger for host cell pyroptosis** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42665643/)
  * Structural and functional studies reveal that specific viral proteases directly cleave host sensor proteins to initiate inflammasome assembly and pyroptotic cell death.

* **DyAb machine-learning framework enables sequence-based antibody engineering** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42665538/)
  * Researchers introduced DyAb, a computational architecture for sequence-based antibody design and property prediction optimized for low-data regimes.

* **Universal structure determination pipeline established for GPCR targets** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42665663/)
  * A novel platform approach achieves high-resolution structural determination of G-protein coupled receptors (GPCRs), accelerating structure-based drug discovery for challenging membrane proteins.

* **Propofol regulates SLC6A2 expression via NAT10-mediated ac⁴C modification in cognitive dysfunction** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42665691/)
  * Mechanistic research shows propofol modulates SLC6A2 expression through N4-acetylcytidine (ac⁴C) RNA modification, attenuating excessive mitophagy and hippocampal neuronal dysfunction in aged models of postoperative cognitive dysfunction.

---

### Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Big Pharma]** **Novartis advances pacibekitug (anti-IL-6) for cardiovascular risk reduction** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/29/novartis-pacibekitug-inflammation-il6-tourmaline-heart-disease/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Pacibekitug, an IL-6-targeting monoclonal antibody acquired from Tourmaline Bio, demonstrated robust biomarker-driven reductions in systemic inflammation.
  * Clinical development is focusing on whether targeting the IL-6 inflammatory pathway can lower major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in high-risk patients.

* **[Biotech]** **Quince Therapeutics reports positive interim Phase 2/3 data for QRX003 in Netherton syndrome** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2093665127077679219)
  * Interim analysis from the Phase 2/3 trial of QRX003 demonstrated positive clinical signals and safety in patients with Netherton syndrome, a rare genetic skin disease.

* **Low-dose cyclobenzaprine fails to show efficacy in sleep bruxism Phase 2 trial** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42666102/)
  * A randomized, double-blind, crossover placebo-controlled trial found that low-dose cyclobenzaprine did not significantly alter electromyographic muscle activity associated with sleep bruxism.

* **Protocol published for EASE-AKI trial evaluating SP16 in cardiac surgery** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42665834/)
  * The prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial is evaluating the peptide drug candidate SP16 to prevent acute kidney injury in high-risk chronic kidney disease patients undergoing elective cardiac surgery with cardiopulmonary bypass.

---

### Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **Potent P2Y₁₂ inhibitors increase bleeding without reducing ischemic events in AF and ACS** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04629-7)
  * Data presented at the 2026 European Society of Cardiology (ESC) Congress showed dual antithrombotic therapy combining direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) with potent P2Y₁₂ inhibitors (ticagrelor or prasugrel) significantly increased bleeding rates compared to DOACs combined with clopidogrel and aspirin in patients with atrial fibrillation and acute coronary syndrome.
  * The potent P2Y₁₂ strategy provided no statistically significant reduction in ischemic events, supporting standard clopidogrel-based regimens in this setting.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Amgen's evolocumab evaluated prior to PCI in acute myocardial infarction (AMUNDSEN trial)** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42666092/)
  * Results from the randomized AMUNDSEN trial evaluated immediate pre-percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) administration of PCSK9 inhibitor evolocumab to acutely lower LDL-C in patients presenting with acute myocardial infarction.

* **[Biotech]** **Xenon Pharmaceuticals to present Phase 3 azetukalner data at EEC 2026** [X / @MarcJacksonLA](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2093665127077679219)
  * Xenon will detail Phase 3 clinical trial results for its Kv7 potassium channel opener, azetukalner, at the upcoming European Epilepsy Congress.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Head-to-head trial compares adalimumab vs. subcutaneous infliximab in axial spondyloarthritis** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42665722/)
  * A randomized controlled trial compared flare rates of acute anterior uveitis (AAU) between adalimumab and subcutaneous infliximab in patients with radiographic axial spondyloarthritis and a history of prior AAU.

---

### Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Biotech]** **FDA approves Protagonist Therapeutics' Mimrylo (rusfertide) as first-in-class treatment for polycythemia vera** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-drug-its-kind-polycythemia-vera-rare-blood-disorder)
  * The FDA approved Mimrylo (rusfertide), an injectable hepcidin mimetic, to reduce red blood cell overproduction and hematocrit levels in adults with polycythemia vera.
  * In the pivotal 32-week Phase 3 VERIFY trial (n=293), 76.9% of patients receiving Mimrylo (subcutaneously once weekly, starting at 19 mg) maintained hematocrit below 45% without requiring phlebotomy between weeks 20 and 32, compared to placebo.
  * The approval triggers a $275M milestone payment to Protagonist Therapeutics, with tiered royalties of 14%–29% and up to $875M in remaining commercial milestones [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2093499264856911874).

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA expands Janssen's Stelara (ustekinumab) approval to pediatric ulcerative colitis** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/fda-approves-stelara-pediatric-ulcerative-colitis)
  * Ustekinumab received FDA approval for pediatric patients aged 2 years and older with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis (UC), building on its prior pediatric Crohn's disease label expansion.
  * Approval was supported by adult UC efficacy trials, pediatric Crohn's PK data, and a dedicated 52-week pediatric UC trial (n=112) in patients aged 3 to 17.

* **[Biotech]** **FDA approves Revolution Medicines' RAS inhibitor for metastatic pancreatic cancer** [X / @VivekSubbiah](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2093665127077679219)
  * The FDA granted approval for Revolution Medicines' targeted therapy, marking a major milestone for RAS-driven metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.

* **[Biotech]** **Celcuity submits sNDA for REVTORPYK (gedatolisib) in PIK3CA-mutant breast cancer** [X / @doepke_michel](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2093665127077679219)
  * Celcuity submitted a supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) for its dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitor gedatolisib in patients with PIK3CA-mutant advanced breast cancer.

* **[Biotech]** **Roivant Sciences secures FDA approval for Lisraya in rare autoimmune condition** [X / @adamfeuerstein](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2093665127077679219)
  * The FDA granted marketing authorization for Roivant's Lisraya for the treatment of a rare autoimmune disease.

* **[Biotech]** **uniQure prepares U.S. BLA and UK filings for Huntington's gene therapy AMT-130** [X / @DrToonces](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2093665127077679219)
  * Following positive 4-year follow-up data, uniQure expects to submit a U.S. Biologics License Application (BLA) and UK regulatory application for its AAV gene therapy candidate AMT-130 by the end of Q3.

* **FDA clears Juul's updated e-cigarette device with age-verification technology** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/28/juul-fda-clearance-updated-ecigarette-age-gating-technology/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * The FDA cleared Juul Labs' next-generation vaping system incorporating an optional age-gating verification system to limit youth access.

---

### Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **Guardant Health patent litigation proceeds to discovery after court ruling** [X / @AuditTheHerd](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2093665127077679219)
  * A federal judge denied motions to dismiss ongoing patent litigation involving Guardant Health, advancing the liquid biopsy IP dispute into discovery.

* **[Biotech]** **Sangamo Therapeutics equity committee seeks bidding deadline extension** [X / @Franca_ole](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2093665127077679219)
  * Sangamo's Official Committee of Equity Security Holders submitted potential bidder communications to support a motion to extend asset acquisition deadlines.

---

### Public Health & Policy

* **FDA and White House launch initiative addressing human xylazine exposure** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/fda-meetings-conferences-and-workshops/mitigating-risks-human-xylazine-exposure-10042023)
  * The FDA, in partnership with the Reagan-Udall Foundation, convened a public health workshop targeting human exposure to the non-opioid veterinary sedative xylazine, often compounded with illicit fentanyl.
  * The agency is prioritizing framework development for targeted drug development, clinical treatment protocols, and harm-reduction strategies to counter rising illicit misuse.

---

**Worth watching:** Protagonist Therapeutics' commercial rollout of Mimrylo (rusfertide) following its first-in-class FDA approval, and uniQure's planned BLA submission for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease by the end of Q3.
